eps.t: How I Spent My Summer XII (The Revenge of Beautiful Downtown Aurora)
eps.o: Yes, this is where it all began. Yes, there’s still a bit of a stench in the air…
The Archive finally grows some funk…maybe we oughta consider showering.
The Archive takes you to heaven*…TV Heaven, that is. *Don’t we always take you to heaven?
The ol’ Archive Saloon is open for business…and is servin’ up some fire water that’ll get ya sued (er, stewed)!
